readings: z is a combinational Moore output of the state entered after the third w sample; it is 1 in the clock cycle immediately following the third sampled cycle.
z is a registered output; it is 1 one clock cycle later, i.e., in the cycle after the decision state.
The next 3-cycle window starts on the same cycle that z is asserted (the cycle immediately after the third sample); w on that cycle is the first sample of the next window.
The cycle after the third sample is an output-only cycle; the next 3-cycle window starts on the following cycle, so there is a one-cycle gap between windows.

ambiguities.aspect: Reset behavior for z and auxiliary counters
readings: Synchronous reset forces z to 0 and clears all internal cycle and ones counters to their initial values.
Reset only forces the main FSM state to A; z and any separate cycle/ones counters retain their previous values (or undefined) and are only cleared by natural rollover.

ambiguities.aspect: Start of w sampling after entering B
readings: The first w sample is taken in the first clock cycle the FSM is in state B (the cycle immediately after s=1 is captured).
The FSM waits one clock cycle after entering B before taking the first of the three w samples.
